name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow with role-pinned Terra / High and Luna / Medium implementation lanes and a budgeted, fresh requested-read-only Sol review.

interface.shortDescription: Architect with Sol, implement with role-pinned Terra / High or the Luna floor lane, and review with Sol.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a delivery workflow: GPT-5.6 Sol orchestrates and classifies each task, a role-pinned GPT-5.6 Terra / High agent handles judgment-bearing implementation while a GPT-5.6 Luna / Medium floor lane takes mechanical edits, and a fresh requested-read-only Sol reviewer must approve the final diff within a bounded review budget.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Classify this task with Sol Advisor and route it to the right implementation lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Sol advisor before reporting done.
